unit.why: A brief first-person anecdote, heard from the tsaddik: he once looked into a philosophical book by an early sage, grew angry and put it down for good. There is a minimal event, so it counts as a story.

stories.start_quote: גם שמעתי ממנו ז״ל שפ״א ראה
stories.summary_en: The tsaddik once looked into a philosophical work by a great early sage, became angry at what he read, and put the book away, refusing to look at it again.

tags.why: He was angered by the philosophical content.

quotes: ומיד הנחתיו מידי ולא רציתי להביט בו עוד
tags.why: He avoids reading philosophy as something forbidden. The previous division gives the same reasoning about heresy.

quotes: רק שהספר הזה הוא בדרך פלוסופיא
tags.why: The scene is reading a book, though the point is rejecting that kind of study.
The tsaddik tells this about himself, and the author passes it on as heard from him.

missing_concepts: rejection of philosophy / medieval Jewish rationalism
